title: Content Credential Signature Verifier
description: Assess a C2PA COSE_Sign1 content-credential signature policy. The caller performs the signature check over the manifest bytes with the declared alg (Ed25519/ES256/ES384/PS256) and attests the outcome via the required signature_verified input; the kernel does not re-verify. Trust posture is caller-supplied: zero network, no OCSP. Emits ACCEPT or REFUSE.

signature_verified.description: result of the caller's signature check over the manifest bytes with the declared alg; the kernel does not re-verify

mcp_tool_definition.description: Assess a C2PA COSE_Sign1 content-credential signature policy. The caller performs the signature check over the manifest bytes with the declared alg and attests the outcome via the required signature_verified input; this tool does not re-verify it. Trust anchor, cert-expiry, and revocation status are caller-supplied inputs, not independently checked. Zero network, no state change, nothing issued or registered. Emits ACCEPT or REFUSE.
